title: Scaling Ads Ranking with Foundation Models at Meta
summary: Meta engineers describe how foundation models are being used to rank ads, sharing the trade-offs between model size, latency, and auction outcomes. The post covers feature design, training data, and how the system is evaluated before shipping. A useful practical companion to the week's arXiv papers on ranking and targeting.

title: How Netflix Personalises the Home Page with Sequence Models
summary: Netflix explains how sequence modelling over viewing history powers home-page personalisation, from candidate generation to ranking. The post discusses cold-start handling, diversity, and the metrics the team watches in A/B tests. It is a clear industry view of sequence modelling in production recommendation.
